details.further_information: His transfer to Al-Nassr FC was worth an initial €77 million, with an additional €15 million in potential add-ons. As part of Durán's 2023 transfer, his former club, Chicago Fire, received an additional 15% of the profit from his 2025 move to Al-Nassr. The original 2023 transfer fee was €16.4 million, plus €3.84 million in add-ons, along with an €8.4 million sell-on fee from the 2025 deal. At €29.5 million, Durán’s departure from Chicago Fire is the most expensive transfer in MLS history.
